items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted file upload vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability, named PolyShell, is an unrestricted file upload flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to send requests to the guest cart API with a disguised image file containing PHP code, leading to code execution. It has been actively exploited and added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones. CVE-2026-103849 (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, and CVE-2026-92909 (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B, also allowing unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) with a CVSS of 9.3, potentially leading to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system, rated CVSS 10.0, and was under active attack.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to take over customer accounts by switching a customer session, granting access to private customer data, with a CVSS score of 9.1.
